title: 鋅溴液流電池循環系統
subcategoryTitle: 電池儲能電站與電池系統
subcategoryTitleEn: Battery storage plants and battery systems
summary: 鋅溴液流電池的充電過程是把溶液裡的鋅離子電鍍在電極上，同時在另一側產生溴；放電時鋅溶回去。鋅與溴都很便宜，電池可以每天完全放空而不損壽命，但它需要定期把電極上殘留的鋅徹底剝除，泵也不能停。加州一處生質能設施裝設了近兩 MWh 的這種電池。課程定量分析鋅的沉積量、泵的待機損失、剝鋅對可用率的影響、能量效率、模組串並聯與比能量。
summaryEn: Charging a zinc-bromine flow battery plates zinc ions from solution onto an electrode while bromine forms on the other side; on discharge the zinc dissolves again. Zinc and bromine are cheap and the battery can be emptied fully every day without harm to life, but zinc left on the electrode must be stripped completely at intervals and pumps cannot stop. A bioenergy facility in California installed nearly two megawatt-hours of such batteries. The course quantifies zinc deposited, standby pump loss, effect of stripping on availability, energy efficiency, module arrangement and specific energy.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：鋅溴液流電池循環系統
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Zinc-Bromine Flow Battery Circulation Systems
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「功率、能量與時長」與「模組數與系統能量」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Power, energy and duration" and "Module count and system energy": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「功率、能量與時長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Power, energy and duration" is correct?
options: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。
儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。
模組越多，系統就越可靠。
optionsEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration.
The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating.
The more modules, the more reliable the system.
quiz.explanation: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「功率、能量與時長」如何決定「鋅溴液流電池循環系統」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Power, energy and duration” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Zinc-Bromine Flow Battery Circulation Systems”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。調頻用的系統時長可能只有半小時到一小時，移轉太陽能尖峰的系統則為四小時或更長。功率與能量之比也稱為 C 率：1C 表示一小時放完，0.25C 表示四小時；C 率越高，電芯發熱越多、壽命與效率越低。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration. Systems for frequency regulation may have half an hour to an hour, while those shifting solar peaks have four hours or more. The power-to-energy ratio is also the C-rate: 1C empties in an hour, 0.25C in four; higher C-rates heat cells more and lower life and efficiency. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：系統由 192 個各 10 kWh 的模組組成，合計約 2 MWh
steps.observationEn: Project file: The system has 192 modules of 10 kWh each, about 2 MWh in all
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「功率、能量與時長」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Power, energy and duration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 功率、能量與時長
knowledge.text: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。調頻用的系統時長可能只有半小時到一小時，移轉太陽能尖峰的系統則為四小時或更長。功率與能量之比也稱為 C 率：1C 表示一小時放完，0.25C 表示四小時；C 率越高，電芯發熱越多、壽命與效率越低。
knowledge.textEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration. Systems for frequency regulation may have half an hour to an hour, while those shifting solar peaks have four hours or more. The power-to-energy ratio is also the C-rate: 1C empties in an hour, 0.25C in four; higher C-rates heat cells more and lower life and efficiency.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 系統由 192 個各 10 kWh 的模組組成，合計約 2 MWh
knowledge.textEn: The system has 192 modules of 10 kWh each, about 2 MWh in all

quiz.question: 依「功率、能量與時長」的模型 t = E / P，額定功率下的放電時長最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model t = E / P for "Power, energy and duration", which value is closest to the discharge duration at rated power?
quiz.explanation: t = E / P；代入 Eb = 2 MWh、Pb = 0.6 MW，得 3.33 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: t = E / P; with Eb = 2 MWh, Pb = 0.6 MW the result is 3.33 h (discharge duration at rated power). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「功率、能量與時長」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Power, energy and duration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = E / P；代入 Eb = 2 MWh、Pb = 0.6 MW，得 3.33 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Pb 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = E / P; with Eb = 2 MWh, Pb = 0.6 MW the result is 3.33 h (discharge duration at rated power). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Pb by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Pb 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3.03 h（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Pb by 10% changes the result to 3.03 h (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 3.33 h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Pb 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 3.33 h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Pb with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: t = E / P；代入 Eb = 2 MWh、Pb = 0.6 MW，得 3.33 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。
knowledge.textEn: t = E / P; with Eb = 2 MWh, Pb = 0.6 MW the result is 3.33 h (discharge duration at rated power).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Pb 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3.03 h（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Pb by 10% changes the result to 3.03 h (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「功率、能量與時長」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Power, energy and duration"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
鋰電池效率超過 95%，所以整座儲能電站的效率也是 95%。
依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Lithium cells exceed 95% efficiency, so the whole storage plant is 95% efficient too.

Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life.
quiz.explanation: 依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「功率、能量與時長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Power, energy and duration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要同時載明交流側可用能量、額定功率、量測點與壽期末保證值，避免直流標稱值與交流可用值混淆。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specifications should state usable AC energy, rated power, measurement point and end-of-life guarantee together, to avoid confusing nominal DC with usable AC values.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。
knowledge.textEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規格書要同時載明交流側可用能量、額定功率、量測點與壽期末保證值，避免直流標稱值與交流可用值混淆。
knowledge.textEn: Specifications should state usable AC energy, rated power, measurement point and end-of-life guarantee together, to avoid confusing nominal DC with usable AC values.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 62933 電能儲存系統標準系列。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 62933 series on electrical energy storage systems. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「功率、能量與時長」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Power, energy and duration" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
模組越多，系統就越可靠。
optionsEn: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
The more modules, the more reliable the system.
quiz.explanation: 若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「功率、能量與時長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Power, energy and duration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「鋅溴液流電池循環系統」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Zinc-Bromine Flow Battery Circulation Systems”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：功率與能量之比也稱為 C 率：1C 表示一小時放完，0.25C 表示四小時；C 率越高，電芯發熱越多、壽命與效率越低。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The power-to-energy ratio is also the C-rate: 1C empties in an hour, 0.25C in four; higher C-rates heat cells more and lower life and efficiency.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。
knowledge.textEn: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表
knowledge.text: 1970：鋅溴液流電池開始發展
knowledge.textEn: 1970: Development of zinc-bromine flow batteries began

quiz.question: 關於「模組數與系統能量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Module count and system energy" is correct?
options: 模組越多，系統就越可靠。
充電只是把電「裝」進電池，裡面沒有東西在移動。
這種電池是以十度電的小模組為單位製造的：每個模組是一個半人高的塑膠箱，裡面有電堆、兩個電解液槽、兩台小泵與控制器，接上直流匯流排就能用。
optionsEn: The more modules, the more reliable the system.
Charging just fills a battery with electricity and nothing moves inside.

This battery is made in small modules of ten units of energy: each a plastic case half a person tall holding a stack, two electrolyte tanks, two small pumps and a controller, ready to use on a DC bus.

steps.title: 模組數與系統能量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Module count and system energy: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「模組數與系統能量」如何決定「鋅溴液流電池循環系統」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Module count and system energy” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Zinc-Bromine Flow Battery Circulation Systems”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 這種電池是以十度電的小模組為單位製造的：每個模組是一個半人高的塑膠箱，裡面有電堆、兩個電解液槽、兩台小泵與控制器，接上直流匯流排就能用。要多大的系統，就把多少個模組串並聯起來。一百九十二個模組先十幾個一串接成高壓，再把各串並聯。模組化的好處是任何一個模組故障或需要維護時，其他的照常運轉；壞處是每個模組都有自己的泵與控制器，零件數量龐大。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: This battery is made in small modules of ten units of energy: each a plastic case half a person tall holding a stack, two electrolyte tanks, two small pumps and a controller, ready to use on a DC bus. A system of any size is modules in series and parallel. A hundred and ninety-two are joined ten-odd to a string for high voltage and the strings paralleled. Modularity lets the rest carry on when one module fails or needs maintenance; its drawback is a pump set and controller for every module and a great many parts. quiz.question: 依「模組數與系統能量」的模型 E = N·e，192 個各 10 kWh 的模組的系統總能量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = N·e for "Module count and system energy", which value is closest to the total system energy of 192 modules of 10 kWh each?
options: 1.92 MWh
19.2 MWh
optionsEn: 1.92 MWh
19.2 MWh
quiz.explanation: E = N·e；代入 N = 192、e = 10 kWh，得 1.92 MWh（192 個各 10 kWh 的模組的系統總能量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = N·e; with N = 192, e = 10 kWh the result is 1.92 MWh (total system energy of 192 modules of 10 kWh each). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 模組數與系統能量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Module count and system energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模組數與系統能量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Module count and system energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = N·e；代入 N = 192、e = 10 kWh，得 1.92 MWh（192 個各 10 kWh 的模組的系統總能量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 N 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = N·e; with N = 192, e = 10 kWh the result is 1.92 MWh (total system energy of 192 modules of 10 kWh each). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise N by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：N 增加 10% 時，結果變為 2.11 MWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising N by 10% changes the result to 2.11 MWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 1.92 MWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 N 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 1.92 MWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in N with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = N·e；代入 N = 192、e = 10 kWh，得 1.92 MWh（192 個各 10 kWh 的模組的系統總能量）。
knowledge.textEn: E = N·e; with N = 192, e = 10 kWh the result is 1.92 MWh (total system energy of 192 modules of 10 kWh each).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: N 增加 10% 時，結果變為 2.11 MWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising N by 10% changes the result to 2.11 MWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模組數與系統能量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Module count and system energy"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以系統層級的完整充放電試驗量測實際可用的能量，並檢查各串之間的電流分配。
電池越少完全放電，壽命就越長。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
A full system charge-discharge test measures usable energy and checks current sharing between strings.
The less often a battery is fully discharged, the longer it lasts.
quiz.explanation: 以系統層級的完整充放電試驗量測實際可用的能量，並檢查各串之間的電流分配。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: A full system charge-discharge test measures usable energy and checks current sharing between strings. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模組數與系統能量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Module count and system energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模組數與系統能量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Module count and system energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以系統層級的完整充放電試驗量測實際可用的能量，並檢查各串之間的電流分配。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: A full system charge-discharge test measures usable energy and checks current sharing between strings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：模組化系統要以直流轉換器隔離各串或各模組，並把大量輔助元件的故障率計入可用率評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Isolate strings or modules with DC converters in a modular system, and count failure rates of the many auxiliaries in availability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一串當中有一個模組進入維護循環而被旁路時，該串的電壓下降，與其他並聯的串之間產生環流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: When one module in a string is bypassed for its maintenance cycle, string voltage falls and current circulates between it and parallel strings. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以系統層級的完整充放電試驗量測實際可用的能量，並檢查各串之間的電流分配。
knowledge.textEn: A full system charge-discharge test measures usable energy and checks current sharing between strings.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 模組化系統要以直流轉換器隔離各串或各模組，並把大量輔助元件的故障率計入可用率評估。
knowledge.textEn: Isolate strings or modules with DC converters in a modular system, and count failure rates of the many auxiliaries in availability.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：UL 9540 儲能系統與設備／UL 9540A 熱失控延燒試驗方法。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: UL 9540 Energy Storage Systems and Equipment / UL 9540A thermal-runaway fire-propagation test method. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「模組數與系統能量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Module count and system energy" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
充電只是把電「裝」進電池，裡面沒有東西在移動。
一串當中有一個模組進入維護循環而被旁路時，該串的電壓下降，與其他並聯的串之間產生環流。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Charging just fills a battery with electricity and nothing moves inside.
When one module in a string is bypassed for its maintenance cycle, string voltage falls and current circulates between it and parallel strings.
quiz.explanation: 一串當中有一個模組進入維護循環而被旁路時，該串的電壓下降，與其他並聯的串之間產生環流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When one module in a string is bypassed for its maintenance cycle, string voltage falls and current circulates between it and parallel strings. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 模組數與系統能量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Module count and system energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模組數與系統能量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Module count and system energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一串當中有一個模組進入維護循環而被旁路時，該串的電壓下降，與其他並聯的串之間產生環流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「鋅溴液流電池循環系統」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: When one module in a string is bypassed for its maintenance cycle, string voltage falls and current circulates between it and parallel strings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Zinc-Bromine Flow Battery Circulation Systems”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：模組化的好處是任何一個模組故障或需要維護時，其他的照常運轉；壞處是每個模組都有自己的泵與控制器，零件數量龐大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Modularity lets the rest carry on when one module fails or needs maintenance; its drawback is a pump set and controller for every module and a great many parts.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模組越多，系統就越可靠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more modules, the more reliable the system." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一串當中有一個模組進入維護循環而被旁路時，該串的電壓下降，與其他並聯的串之間產生環流。
knowledge.textEn: When one module in a string is bypassed for its maintenance cycle, string voltage falls and current circulates between it and parallel strings.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
